text:
I'm sorry to hear that happened. Yes, you can get a replacement—but there's an important limit:

A replacement plant gets its own new 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced **once more** if it fails. However, **the plant sent as that second replacement has no guarantee**, so that would be the final one.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit a claim within your guarantee window (30 days from delivery, or 90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member) with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days.

If you need support with this claim, I'm happy to help—do you have your original order number handy?
